data.value: The report opens on GitHub, where it is public. Passwords, keys in addresses, e-mail addresses, locator and coordinates are removed before sending; even so, please check the preview. You need a GitHub account to send it. You may write in English; the report's section headings stay in Spanish for the developer.

data.value: To report a bug, use “Report a bug” instead: it prepares the report with the version and your rig, and you see everything that is sent before it is sent.
